title: How to organize the guest dresser | Guest Bedroom
description:
Somewhere a guest can unpack, so they stop living out of a half open suitcase on the floor.

This is the Guest Dresser in the Guest Bedroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
The top two drawers completely empty and lined, the lower drawers holding spare linens folded to one uniform footprint with a label on the inside front edge, an anti-tip strap fixed to the wall, and the dresser top carrying a lamp or a mirror and nothing else.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: This is where the household's undecided things hide behind a closed front: off-season jumpers, a bin of cables
Straighten: Put the empty drawers at the top, where a guest opens first and bends least, and the spare linens underneath,
Shine: Vacuum inside each drawer and wipe the runners, then leave the empty drawers open with the window cracked whil
Safety: A dresser with two empty top drawers is lighter at the top than it looks, and a visiting child will climb it.
Standardize: Write on a label inside each empty drawer's front edge: reserved, guest.
Sustain: During your own seasonal wardrobe change, you open these two drawers in the same trip and confirm they are sti

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Top two drawers empty and labelled reserved, lower drawers holding only spare linens for this room's bed, strap fixed to the wall.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/guest-bedroom-the-guest-dresser.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
